title: Member
description: A person registered to borrow tools, known to the library by their email.

title: Tool
description: One physical item in the catalog, known by the number on its tag.

title: Damage report
description: What is wrong with a tool while it needs repair, from the report until a librarian marks the tool repaired.

title: Loan
description: One member holding one tool, from borrowing to return.

title: Return
description: The end of a loan: when the tool came back and what the librarian found, recorded once and never changed.
